svg.title: Dominion's metered data-center demand rises in step with our estimate, but explains part of it

cc:Work.dc:title: Dominion's metered data-center demand rises in step with our estimate, but explains part of it
cc:Work.dc:description: Line chart: Dominion's metered data-center demand rose about 1,373 MW from 2022 to 2025; our weather-adjusted estimate for the zone rose 2,301 MW.
